Package com.hiface.sdk.frame

Class RgbIrFrame

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.frame.RgbIrFrame
public final class RgbIrFrame extends java.lang.Object
Software-paired RGB YUV and actual near-infrared GRAY8 input for 1:N search with IR liveness.

Pixels are borrowed only until HiFaceSdk.processFrame(pair) returns. Construction and getters do not copy pixels. Do not retain a pair from a UVC callback or queue it to another thread for later submission. IR must already be upright and unmirrored. RGB uses Yuv420Frame rotation. Calibration maps the rotated, unmirrored coordinate spaces.

Both timestamps must use the same millisecond clock as SystemClock.elapsedRealtime(). UVC callback times indicate software pairing, not synchronized hardware exposure. Use a new sourceId each time the paired camera opens. Within one source, pairId and both sequences must increase strictly; do not consume old frames again.
